text: {"lessons":["I sold B, E and C after gains, but a gain relative to my purchase price is not by itself a reason to sell; I should assess each holding's risk and role in my portfolio.","My account value fluctuated while I made no trades, so I should not mistake monthly changes for evidence that I need to act.","Because past price changes do not predict future ones, I should base each decision on my current plan and avoid chasing recent moves."]}
